issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §5.6.6 upper() and §5.6.7 lower()
issues.evidence: Fresh FP-10 EXPLORER probe compared native DuckDB C++ and forced Python fallback on Unicode string-transform cases. Native turkish_upper.lower() returned ['İstanbul'] while fallback returned ['i̇stanbul']; native turkish_lower.upper() returned ['ıSTANBUL'] while fallback returned ['ISTANBUL']; native greek_accent_lower.upper() returned ['άέήίόύώ'] while fallback returned ['ΆΈΉΊΌΎΏ']; native greek_accent_upper.lower() returned ['ΆΈΉΊΌΎΏ'] while fallback returned ['άέήίόύώ']. Probe log: .temp/qa/fp10_explorer_probe.log.
issues.root_cause: Native C++ fn_upper/fn_lower use a local UTF-8 case-mapping table. The table handled ASCII, Latin-1, much of Latin Extended-A, basic Greek, and Cyrillic, but omitted special-case dotted/dotless Turkish I and accented Greek vowel mappings.
issues.resolution: Extended native fn_upper/fn_lower case mapping for U+0130, U+0131, U+03AC/U+03AD/U+03AE/U+03AF/U+03CC/U+03CD/U+03CE and U+0386/U+0388/U+0389/U+038A/U+038C/U+038E/U+038F, plus Greek dialytika pairs U+03CA/U+03CB and U+03AA/U+03AB. Added native sqllogictest and native-vs-forced-fallback parity coverage, rebuilt and copied the bundled extension.
